title: Stoker plugins — compiled index
description: What a host reads from a registry: compiled from the registry's tree on every change, never edited. `index/v1/plugins.json.zst` is this document as JSON, compressed with zstd: the registry's publishers and policy, and every plugin with every version. `index/v1/plugins/<key>.json` is one plugin's part alone, uncompressed (`$defs/pluginDocument`), for a host that wants one plugin without the whole index. Both are pinned by hash in `timestamp.json`, which is the only signed file: a host checks the timestamp's signature, then each file it reads against the timestamp.

serial.description: The same serial as the `timestamp.json` that pins this file.

pluginEntry.description: One plugin: its `plugin.yaml` and every version's `<version>.yaml`, as JSON, versions in ascending order.

pluginDocument.description: `index/v1/plugins/<key>.json`: one plugin's entry, with the registry and serial it was compiled in.
